```artifact
@start
    Initial state: Idle
    
    Pressure Fall Phase:
        - Event: Set Target Pressure
        - Guard: Pressure below target pressure
        - Transition: Start Pressure Fall
        - Event: Pressure Reached Target
        - Guard: Pressure within 0.8*PEEP-1 cmH2O of target pressure
        - Transition: Pressure Fall Completed
        
    PEEP Phase:
        - Event: Set Target PEEP
        - Guard: PEEP within 1 H2O + 10% of target PEEP
        - Transition: Start PEEP Adjustment
        - Event: PEEP Reached Target
        - Guard: PEEP within 1 H2O + 10% of target PEEP
        - Transition: PEEP Adjustment Completed
        
    FiO2 Phase:
        - Event: Set Target FiO2
        - Guard: FiO2 within 0.05 of target FiO2
        - Transition: Start FiO2 Adjustment
        - Event: FiO2 Reached Target
        - Guard: FiO2 within 0.05 of target FiO2
        - Transition: FiO2 Adjustment Completed
        
    Air Conditions Phase:
        - Event: Set Air Conditions
        - Guard: Air conditions match target conditions
        - Transition: Start Air Conditions Adjustment
        - Event: Air Conditions Reached Target
        - Guard: Air conditions match target conditions
        - Transition: Air Conditions Adjustment Completed
        
    Assist/Control Phase:
        - Event: Detect Patient Inspiration
        - Guard: True
        - Transition: Start Inspiration
        
    Safety Measures Phase:
        - Event: Receive Absurd Command
        - Guard: True
        - Transition: Ignore Command
        
@end
```
